info.name: Meenakshi - Phase 7 guided workflow extension
info.description: Supplement to the existing Phase 7 operations collection. Verifies connector recovery role boundaries, sanitized message/document reads, and review-only guards. Do not run the credential-rotation request on a bridge that is currently in use unless you intend to re-pair it.

exec: pm.test('alerts carry a safe detail target when one is available', () => pm.expect(body.alerts || []).to.be.an('array'));

pm.test('health omits raw Tally XML and provider secrets', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('<ENVELOPE'); pm.expect(text.toLowerCase()).to.not.include('msg91_authkey'); });

item.name: 2. Finance Approver cannot rotate a bridge credential
3. Administrator rotates bridge credential (intentional recovery test)

exec: pm.test('credential rotation is Administrator-only and returns a one-time token', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('only the immediate response contains the one-time control token', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().controlToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

item.description: Run only with a disposable/local connector. Immediately use the returned value in the Tally-host configure command and pair again.

item.name: 4. Finance Approver reads sanitized message detail

exec: pm.test('authorized message detail is readable', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('detail has no raw payload or provider response', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('template_snapshot'); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('provider_response'); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('provider_metadata'); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('payload'); });

item.name: 5. Finance Approver reads safe verified-document state

exec: pm.test('verified document state is readable', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('response has no raw storage path', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('document_storage_path'));

item.name: 6. Finance Approver cannot deactivate a company binding

exec: pm.test('Finance Approver is forbidden from binding changes', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
